claim.claim-text: 1. A method for updating the location information on a gas detector device, the method comprising:

receiving, by a gas detector device, a wireless beacon, when the gas detector device passes within the range of the wireless beacon, wherein the wireless beacon contains location information; updating, by the gas detector device, the location information stored on the gas detector device using the location information from the wireless beacon; and associating, by the gas detector device, subsequent readings taken by one or more sensors of the gas detector device with the updated location information, wherein the wireless beacon may communicate a location ID, wherein the gas detector may access a table with the location ID to input information associated with that location ID and may simply store the location ID in a memory.
2. The method of claim 1 further comprising:
3. The method of claim 1 further comprising repeating one or more steps of the method when the gas detector device passes within the range of a new wireless beacon.
4. The method of claim 1 further comprising communicating, by the gas detector device, the updated location information to a remote monitoring station.
5. The method of claim 1, wherein the wireless beacon is located at one or more critical areas of a facility.
6. The method of claim 1, wherein the wireless beacon is located at one or more entrances to locations within a facility.
7. The method of claim 1, wherein the gas detector receives the wireless beacon via a wireless receiver incorporated into the gas detector device.
8. The method of claim 1, wherein updating, by the gas detector device, the location information stored on the gas detector device occurs automatically.
9. The method of claim 1 further comprising receiving a confirmation input from the user before updating the location information stored on the gas detector device.
10. A gas detector device (102) comprising:

receive and store readings from the one or more sensors (103) of the gas detector (102), receive location information from the wireless beacons (105), update the location information stored in the memory (116) of the gas detector device (102) using the received location information, and associate subsequent readings from the one or more sensors (103) with the updated location information, wherein the wireless beacon may communicate a location ID, wherein the gas detector may access a table with the location ID to input information associated with that location ID and may simply store the location ID in a memory.
11. The gas detector device (102) of claim 10, wherein the processor (114) is further operable to:

receive second location information from a second wireless beacon (105), update the location information stored in the memory (116) of the gas detector device (102) using the received second location information, and associate subsequent readings from the one or more sensors (103) with the updated second location information.
12. The gas detector device (102) of claim 10, wherein the one or more wireless beacons (105) are located at critical areas of a facility (200).
13. The gas detector device (102) of claim 10, wherein the one or more wireless beacons (105) are located at one or more entrances (211, 212, 213) to locations within a facility (200).
14. The gas detector device (102) of claim 10, wherein the one or more wireless beacons (105) are incorporated into location indicators (104).
15. The gas detector device (102) of claim 10, wherein the processor (114) is further operable to:

present a confirmation message to the user via a user interface (110) of the gas detector device (102), and receive a confirmation input from the user before updating the location information stored on the gas detector device (102).
